text: {"summary":"Cluster 'big' scores poorly on kubescape frameworks (NSA 40.0, MITRE 42.0). The most serious issue is the core/DaemonSet/agent workload, which is flagged as a privileged container with a hostPath mount and carries a CRITICAL openssl CVE. The cluster-admin binding to Group system:masters looks like a platform default. The remaining failures are many MEDIUM/LOW controls across app namespaces, and node/control-plane checks were not performed.","targets":["big"],"frameworks":[{"name":"NSA","passed":5,"failed":45,"skipped":5,"score":40.0},{"name":"MITRE","passed":6,"failed":40,"skipped":5,"score":42.0}],"findings":[{"severity":"CRITICAL","title":"Privileged DaemonSet with hostPath mount","resource":"core/DaemonSet/agent","controls":["C-0057","C-0048","Trivy PSS 3"],"evidence":"Kubescape flags C-0057 (Privileged container, 2 resources) and C-0048 (HostPath mount, 2 resources) with core/DaemonSet/agent as example, and Trivy PSS control 3 (Privileged Containers) fails with 2 fails.","fix":"kubectl -n core patch ds agent --type=json -p='[{\"op\":\"replace\",\"path\":\"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/securityContext/privileged\",\"value\":false}]'  # also remove or narrow hostPath volumes to readOnly specific paths, and add only required capabilities"},{"severity":"CRITICAL","title":"openssl CVE-2025-90002 in agent image","resource":"core/DaemonSet/agent","controls":["CVE-2025-90002"],"evidence":"Trivy reports CRITICAL CVE-2025-90002 in openssl installed 1.1.1, fixed in 3.0.13, on core/DaemonSet/agent (1 critical vuln total).","fix":"Rebuild/update the agent image so openssl is >= 3.0.13, then: kubectl -n core set image ds/agent <container>=<repo>/agent:<patched-tag>"},{"severity":"MEDIUM","title":"cluster-admin bound to system:masters group","resource":"ClusterRoleBinding/cluster-admin","controls":[],"evidence":"rbac_and_argo shows binding cluster-admin to role cluster-admin with subject Group:/system:masters; this looks like the Kubernetes platform default, and no wildcard custom roles or other admin subjects appear in the digest.","fix":"kubectl get clusterrolebinding cluster-admin -o yaml  # confirm it is the default; restrict membership of system:masters in the identity provider/certificates and avoid using it for daily access"},{"severity":"MEDIUM","title":"Many application workloads failing kubescape controls (MEDIUM)","resource":"app1..app38 Deployments (e.g. app1/Deployment/svc1)","controls":["C-0301","C-0302","C-0304","C-0305","C-0307","C-0308","C-0310","C-0311","C-0313","C-0314","C-0316","C-0317","C-0319","C-0320","C-0322","C-0323","C-0325","C-0326","C-0328","C-0329","C-0331","C-0332","C-0334","C-0335","C-0337","C-0338"],"evidence":"26 controls named 'Synthetic control N' fail at MEDIUM severity, each affecting 4 to 41 resources; the digest gives no further detail on what each checks.","fix":"kubescape scan control <C-ID> --verbose  # review each failing control's remediation per control and apply via the deployment manifests"},{"severity":"LOW","title":"Many application workloads failing kubescape controls (LOW)","resource":"app0..app39 Deployments (e.g. app0/Deployment/svc0)","controls":["C-0300","C-0303","C-0306","C-0309","C-0312","C-0315","C-0318","C-0321","C-0324","C-0327","C-0330","C-0333","C-0336","C-0339"],"evidence":"14 controls named 'Synthetic control N' fail at LOW severity, each affecting 3 to 42 resources; the digest gives no further detail on what each checks.","fix":"kubescape scan control <C-ID> --verbose  # triage and batch-fix in the deployment templates"}],"not_checked":[{"item":"node and control-plane CIS checks","reason":"need a privileged node-collector pod; the audit identity is read-only"},{"item":"git history","reason":"secrets removed from history are not scanned"},{"item":"Specifics of the 'Synthetic control' failures","reason":"the digest gives only control IDs, severities and resource counts, not what each control checks"},{"item":"Repositories","reason":"the digest contains no repo scan data (repos is empty)"}]}
